models.name: Silero VAD v4
models.description: Voice activity detection used by every realtime pipeline (dictation, live sessions, chat turn-taking). k2-fsa's 16 kHz export of Silero v4 (the id predates that correction). Language-agnostic, ~2 MB resident.

models.name: Zipformer streaming EN
models.description: Streaming Zipformer transducer for English (LibriSpeech-trained, uppercase, no punctuation) — a lightweight fallback for slower machines. Includes fp32 and int8 weights (int8 preferred at load).

models.name: Nemotron 3.5 streaming (EN/FR, 560 ms)
models.description: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 cache-aware streaming transducer (int8) — live recognition with partial results (playground streaming tool and ASR bench). One model covers 40 locales including English and French, with automatic language detection, and outputs punctuated, cased text. 560 ms chunks.

models.name: Kroko streaming FR
models.description: Small streaming Zipformer transducer for French (Banafo Kroko community model) — punctuated, cased output at a fraction of Nemotron's size and CPU cost. French only.

models.name: Whisper small (multilingual)
models.description: Offline Whisper small (99 languages) — covers languages beyond Parakeet's 25, but slower and less accurate on English and French. Includes fp32 and int8 weights; inline punctuation built in.

models.name: Parakeet TDT v3 (25 languages)
models.description: NVIDIA NeMo Parakeet TDT v3 transducer (int8) — fast, accurate offline transcription for dictation, imports and sessions across 25 European languages including English and French, with automatic language detection and built-in punctuation.

models.name: Kokoro EN v0.19
models.description: Fast multi-voice English TTS (11 voices) — the default voice for chat replies and read-aloud.

models.name: Piper FR (SIWIS, medium)
models.description: French VITS/Piper voice (fr_FR-siwis, medium quality) — the local French stock voice.

models.name: ZipVoice Distill int8 (zh/en)
models.description: Zero-shot voice cloning from a short reference recording, fully on-device. English and Chinese only — French clones fall back to ElevenLabs. Ships with the Vocos 24 kHz vocoder. Non-commercial weights (trained on the CC-BY-NC Emilia dataset).

models.name: CAM++ VoxCeleb (3D-Speaker)
models.description: Speaker embedding extractor trained on VoxCeleb — powers speaker identification, verification, and diarization naming for enrolled People.

models.name: Pyannote segmentation 3.0
models.description: Speaker segmentation for offline diarization (who spoke when) — pairs with the speaker embedding model for clustering. Language-agnostic. Includes fp32 and int8 weights (int8 preferred at load).

models.name: CT-Transformer punctuation (zh/en)
models.description: Adds punctuation and casing to raw ASR output when the engine leaves none (punctuating engines like Parakeet and Nemotron skip it). English and Chinese — no local French punctuation model exists yet (spec §5 gap). fp32 weights; the int8 build gives the same output at a quarter of the size.

models.name: CT-Transformer punctuation int8 (zh/en)
models.description: Int8 build of the CT-Transformer punctuator — same output at a quarter of the size. Adds punctuation and casing to raw ASR output when the engine leaves none (punctuating engines like Parakeet and Nemotron skip it). English and Chinese only.

models.name: Zipformer KWS (GigaSpeech, EN)
models.description: Streaming keyword spotter (3.3M params) trained on GigaSpeech — powers the playground keyword-spotting bench. Keywords are supplied as BPE tokens; ships bundled defaults (HELLO WORLD, HEY SIRI, …).

models.name: Spleeter 2-stems (fp16)
models.description: Offline source separation splitting a clip into vocals + accompaniment (Deezer Spleeter, fp16) — the playground source-separation bench. Language-agnostic; file input only.

models.name: Whisper tiny (language ID)
models.description: Multilingual Whisper tiny encoder/decoder for spoken-language identification (99 languages) — the playground language-ID bench. Returns a single top language.

models.name: Whisper base (language ID)
models.description: Multilingual Whisper base for spoken-language identification (99 languages) — more reliable than tiny on short or noisy clips, at under twice the size. Returns a single top language.
